notes:
Same three-rail ladder as circuit_1122 but drawn rotated ~90 deg and tilted ~6 deg, and the cleaned 512x512 crop cuts off the top and bottom of the drawing (components 0, 2, 3 have negative bbox y and components 1, 18 sit below y=512 - they are annotated but not visible). Three near-vertical rails: rail L through capacitor 7 (1uF, y~72) and inductor 5 (y~308) - x goes 106 at y=0 to 178 at y=509; rail M through capacitor 8 (9uF, y~183) and inductor 6 (4uH, y~434) - x goes 249 at y=0 to 302 at y=505; rail R through inductor 4 (5uH, y~51) and capacitor 9 (15uF, y~294) - x goes ~379 at y=-20 to 428 at y=494. Four near-horizontal rungs at y~132 (diode 10 | zener 16), y~232 (zener 17 | diode 11), y~359 (diode 12 | zener 15) and y~503 (diode 14 | diode 13); each rung runs rail L -> rail M -> rail R with one device either side of rail M. The off-frame top rung (y~-20) carries I-DC 3 between rail L and rail M and V-AC 2 between rail M and rail R, with GND 0 hanging off rail M above it. The off-frame bottom carries resistor 18 from the lower end of rail M leftwards to GND 1.
Net map: 0 = rail M TOP segment - GND 0, right terminal of I-DC 3, left terminal of V-AC 2, the rung-1 mid point (right end of diode 10, left end of zener 16) and the top plate of capacitor 8; by the all-grounds-are-one-reference rule this net also carries GND 1 and the grounded end of resistor 18. n1 = rail L top stub: left terminal of I-DC 3 down to the top plate of capacitor 7. n2 = rail L middle: bottom plate of capacitor 7 -> left end of diode 10 (rung 1) -> left end of zener 17 (rung 2) -> top of inductor 5. n3 = rail L bottom: bottom of inductor 5 -> left end of diode 12 (rung 3) -> left end of diode 14 (rung 4), where rail L ends in a corner at (178,509). n4 = rail R top stub: right terminal of V-AC 2 down to the top of inductor 4. n5 = rail R middle: bottom of inductor 4 -> right end of zener 16 (rung 1) -> right end of diode 11 (rung 2) -> top plate of capacitor 9. n6 = rail R bottom: bottom plate of capacitor 9 -> right end of zener 15 (rung 3) -> right end of diode 13 (rung 4), where rail R ends in a corner at (428,494). n7 = rail M middle: bottom plate of capacitor 8 -> rung-2 mid point (right end of zener 17, left end of diode 11) -> rung-3 mid point (right end of diode 12, left end of zener 15) -> top of inductor 6. n8 = rail M bottom: bottom of inductor 6 -> rung-4 mid point (right end of diode 14, left end of diode 13) -> continues below y=512 to the right terminal of resistor 18.
Judgment calls: (a) each rung meets rail L and rail R as a clean T/corner, but CROSSES rail M as a plain cross with no junction dot and no hop (checked all four at 5-14x). Read as junctions, for the same reason as circuit_1122: otherwise rail M would be a source-less closed loop GND0 - C8 - L6 - R18 - GND1 carrying no current, C8/L6/R18 would be pointless, and the four rungs would simply short rail L to rail R through two series diodes each. No hop symbol is drawn anywhere in this image. (b) Verified at 14x that rail M is the ONLY rail that continues past rung 4 (rail L corners at (178,509), rail R corners at (428,494), rail M still descending at y=512) - this is what ties rail M to the off-frame resistor 18 / GND 1. (c) Components 0, 1, 2, 3 and 18 are outside the 512x512 crop; their nets are assigned from their annotated bbox positions relative to the extrapolated rails (I-DC 3 spans x 163-210 between rail L at x~103 and rail M at x~247; V-AC 2 spans x 287-333 between rail M and rail R at x~379; GND 0 sits at x~242 directly over rail M; resistor 18 spans x 209-269 with GND 1 at x 138-170 to its left and rail M at x~307 to its right) plus the structural match to circuit_1122, which is the same schematic. This is the main thing a human should re-check against the raw photo. (d) Terminal order: top-then-bottom for the in-rail vertical parts (4,5,6,7,8,9) and left-then-right for the rung devices and the off-frame horizontal parts (2,3,10-18), as drawn.
